description.value:
From Wonder of U · Price: it only hits creatures that pursue you, and its power grows slowly.

Theme Fate

  • 1: A creature that moves toward you, targets you or Seeks you takes @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] from a minor accident (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}), once per round; on a failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of its next turn and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 2} on a critical failure). Misfortune follows your stand too: a creature that targets your stand suffers its own minor accident the same way (once per round, apart from yours). Bad omen: 1 action: you mark a creature within 30 ft for misfortune and an accident strikes it at once: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}), with the same effects as a minor accident on a failure or critical failure.
  • 5: A creature that critically fails also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}. Your bad omen can mark two creatures at once.
  • 9: Surge, reaction: when a creature moves toward you or targets you, it takes @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage from a major accident (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 13: Allies are never targeted.
  • 17: A critical failure also leaves the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
